description:
List instance types

What can be started: each model with its machines. A machine is sized like a share of one 8-GPU node of a class (gpuClass: the class the model is offered on; size in eighths of a node: 1, 2, 4 or 8) and has a spec (parallel streams, target output tokens a second per stream, context), the limits that follow from it, and our price per hour and per second (null while no price is known). Prices follow the market and are fixed for an instance once it starts. available is false while instances are not open yet.
